author: puffery
quote: I registered an account to rate this game, and i don't usually do that but I feel I had to in this case. GTA6 is not a terrible game by any means but I can't help but feel mislead. The game strays so far from what you expect from the GTA franchise, its focus on realism and being a faithful partner in your relationship for example have taken away from the freedom of playing a phantasy game. More importantly the terrible framerate makes it almost unplayable at times. Its just not what I was expecting.
